name: Sabur Hassan Baidya
title: Assistant Professor; Director, Autonomous Intelligent Mobile Systems Lab
fitReason: Concrete learned visual interface driving a physical UAV, combined with robotics-specific edge inference and safe-learning research.

physicalEvidence.summary: The full ICUAS 2025 author manuscript implements MediaPipe/YOLOv4 hand localization plus a custom-trained gesture classifier on a nearby laptop, returning movement commands to a real DJI Tello over Wi-Fi. Separate AirSim experiments are distinguished. Reported sensing-to-movement latency is about150ms; the headline under30ms concerns processing, not the entire loop. This is human gesture-commanded flight, not a learned autonomous navigation policy. The PI independently identifies the lead author as a summer intern in his Louisville lab, supporting directed-group attribution. Small-platform evaluation and incompletely separated performance claims warrant physical23. ACCESS-AV’s 2025/26 work is simulated localization plus Jetson energy measurement, while the learned-CBF target-tracking paper uses AirSim; neither is added as another physical deployment.
